title: Mote Run implementation plan
scope: Planning only. Task IDs below are stable design IDs, not imported Mote issues or execution authorization.
first_workload: Code changes in one repository, selected by the user on 2026-09-19.
objective: Complete one contracted task with recoverable execution, explicit resource assurance and independent exact-artifact acceptance.
exclusions: No new task graph or generic workflow language
No automatic Git integration in the first usable pilot
No parallel workers, automatic lessons, cross-provider routing or acceptance-grade cache transfer in the initial release
execution_rules: Recheck source, installed binary and applicable Mote review gates at implementation time; this plan does not qualify the current release.

Create or reuse one Mote issue per implementable slice when work starts, preserving MR IDs in tags/body. Use nonblocking parent relations for organization and dependency edges only for real prerequisites.
Before each edit, check and reserve exact paths. Do broad implementation in an isolated checkout when the shared checkout is dirty.
Every task below starts planned. Attach exact source/artifact identities, commands and failure cases before marking implementation complete.
MR-01 through MR-09 form the initial code path. MR-05 and MR-06 can proceed independently after MR-04; this is a dependency property, not an instruction to launch agents.
After each stage, retain failed cases and release claims. Stop dependent rollout on a failed gate rather than reducing assurance labels or acceptance requirements.
Run focused tests for each slice and the repository-required Rust fmt, strict clippy and all-target/all-feature tests for the integrated implementation. Run web checks only if web code changes.
No current production acceptance is inferred from historical tracker closure or a bare successful CLI exit.

stages.title: Freeze the small executable contract
stages.gate: Agree on the code-first slice, trust boundary and versioned minimal exchanges; distinguish unavailable historical files from current validation.

stages.title: Complete the nonbillable loop
stages.gate: A fake task survives success, failure, a stale guard, a lost reply and a controller restart with exactly one logical launch and zero model calls.

stages.title: Qualify one sequential execution path
stages.gate: One real harness passes process, access, accounting and cancellation conformance under explicitly stated assurance; no unattended use before its boundary passes.

stages.title: Deliver independently accepted candidates
stages.gate: Protected checks and independent roles accept the exact candidate; failures/checkpoints remain explicit; manual integration is reconciled before any landing-required task completes.

stages.title: Extend outcomes and measure product value
stages.gate: Each extension passes its own gate. Freeze and run paired evaluation before claiming economic gains or optimizing provider choice.

stages.title: Add only measured optimizations
stages.gate: Additional profiles, lessons and view/cache optimization are individually qualified; none can change authority or success criteria.

stages.title: Qualify bounded concurrency
stages.gate: Concurrent launches cannot oversubscribe resources, duplicate owned execution or bypass serialized integration; sequential mode remains a supported fallback.

milestones.title: Nonbillable demonstrator
milestones.claim: Runnable fake observe-to-evidence loop; no real-provider or sandbox assurance.

milestones.title: First usable code pilot
milestones.claim: Sequential qualified execution and independent candidate acceptance, with explicit external manual landing.

milestones.title: Automatic local integration
milestones.claim: Exact authorized fast-forward into a controller-owned target with crash reconciliation; remote publication remains separately configured.

milestones.title: Analysis workflow
milestones.claim: Independent exact-artifact acceptance without synthetic commits; separately piloted.

milestones.title: Measured ergonomics and economics
milestones.claim: Report the observed comparison, including failure/human costs; an inconclusive result grants no optimization claim.

tasks.title: Freeze core exchanges and the contract model
tasks.outcome: A minimal versioned design that the fake and real implementations can both satisfy.
deliverables: Strict types/schema for contract, situation, ticket, action result, receipt and resource assurance.
Task binding CAS, role mapping, parent counters, completion semantics and canonical idempotency payload definition.
Positive/negative fixtures and traceability to the initial subset of PRD requirements.
acceptance: Missing or unknown critical authority/budget fields and unsupported versions are rejected.
Historical assertions, stale evidence and missing inputs cannot satisfy an obligation.
Document which PRD features are deferred; preserve current tracker/candidate wire behavior.
falsifiers: A worker-provided actor or ticket grants authorizer privilege.
Changing a contract resets parent spending or attempt limits.

tasks.title: Build the durable journal and artifact substrate
tasks.outcome: Actions and coupled reservations survive crashes, and referenced bytes remain verifiable.
deliverables: Single-writer local domain lock and versioned append-only transactions with replayable indices.
Atomic action/launch-intent/resource reservation and durable outbox identity.
Immutable objects/manifests, pinning, integrity and sensitivity-aware retrieval; no automatic GC.
acceptance: Crash every write boundary; recover one committed intent or an explicit unresolved state, never a duplicate refund/launch.
Missing sequence, corrupt committed record and missing artifact fail closed without erasing historical evidence.
Same intent/key replays; different intent/key reuse rejects; revoked callers cannot retrieve protected results.
falsifiers: Controller restart drops unsettled liability.
Corrupt evidence is replaced by a similarly named current file.

tasks.title: Implement situations and one admission evaluator
tasks.outcome: One passive observation explains a scoped task and its genuinely admissible alternatives.
deliverables: Full situation snapshots with declared basis/omissions and bounded inspect.
Shared typed admission result for preview, explanation and execution.
Dependency guards, semantic view cursor, expiry-aware bounded waiting and structured errors.
acceptance: Same basis/principal/policy produces identical preview and execution reasons.
Contract or permission changes invalidate affected tickets; unrelated notes do not.
Required-context overflow blocks honestly; pinned inspect reads exact bytes.
Observe/inspect/wait produce no ops, renewals, external probes or inference calls; late Mote operations surface contradictions.
falsifiers: Every timestamp tick wakes an agent.
A passive status request repairs the journal or acknowledges a message.

tasks.title: Ship the complete fake-runner vertical slice
tasks.outcome: A user can exercise observe, inspect, propose, act, wait and recovery without credentials or spending.
deliverables: Fake adapter with controlled time, outcomes, process handles and usage events.
mote run commands backed by the same kernel; no production profiles enabled.
A reproducible regression-repair fixture with success, failed check, cancellation and unknown launch.
acceptance: Lost reply and restart return the existing action and preserve evidence/usage state.
Stale guard launches nothing; unknown launch prevents replacement.
One observation plus targeted inspection reconstructs the fixture after cold start.
Existing command discovery, JSON envelopes and standalone tracker regression checks remain valid.
falsifiers: A fake pass is displayed as real-profile qualification.
Success depends on retaining the original conversation.

tasks.title: Prove worker isolation and process recovery
tasks.outcome: One tested environment contains untrusted repository execution and surviving children.
deliverables: A time-bounded platform spike selecting an enforceable sandbox/VM/OS boundary.
Attempt-isolated workspaces and recoverable owned launch identity.
Trusted adapter separation from repository tools, scoped worker API and documented assurance matrix.
acceptance: Host/control files, policy/check definitions and credentials cannot be read or modified from repository commands.
Out-of-path writes, symlink escapes, nested model launches and inherited credential/network routes are denied under the claimed boundary.
Kill controller around spawn; successor contains or identifies old execution before replacement.
Prove child containment, reused-PID refusal, cancellation grace/fallback and sleep/resume behavior.
falsifiers: A private directory or actor name is the only credential protection.
An old worker still writes after a successor treats it as fenced.
release_blockers: No unattended real-worker rollout if the selected environment cannot enforce the required boundary.

tasks.title: Implement parent budgets and unsettled accounting
tasks.outcome: Admission respects explicit resource guarantees and preserves uncertain liability.
deliverables: Integer/unit-aware account, run, task and attempt ledger.
Raw usage observations and exactly-once normalization/partial settlement.
Separate assurance for observed usage, execution limits and strict per-request monetary control.
acceptance: Duplicate/out-of-order cumulative and delta events cannot double count or refund twice.
Missing usage, local cancellation and provider timeout retain conservative liability.
Consultation/review/repair and infrastructure retries share parent ceilings and declared counters.
Unknown tariffs or unbounded request charges reject hard-bound admission; other account users are outside any local guarantee.
falsifiers: Absent telemetry counts as zero.
A profile switch or contract revision renews the budget.
release_blockers: Real paid conformance requires explicit account authorization and verified current tariff/charge bounds.

tasks.title: Qualify one native harness adapter
tasks.outcome: Exactly one real implementation route can be admitted at its proved assurance level.
deliverables: Probe/start/observe/cancel/recover contract over a pinned harness/configuration.
Dated official-source profile record for actual model/auth/tool/price semantics; secrets external.
Recorded adapter fixtures plus small explicitly authorized live conformance evidence.
acceptance: Inspect installed behavior and official current documentation before choosing the profile; examples do not enable it.
Verify effective model/configuration, bounded native tools, process recovery and usage semantics.
Cross-session recovery needs pinned artifacts/manifests, not private reasoning or raw transcripts.
Provider loss/checkpoint resumes only under the existing parent envelope; native delegation stays disabled.
falsifiers: The harness reports cancellation while children or unknown provider effects are silently forgotten.
A model alias is recorded as an immutable vendor version.
release_blockers: MR-05 boundary and MR-06 required assurance must pass for this exact adapter/auth mode.

tasks.title: Bridge protected verification to current candidate semantics
tasks.outcome: Submitted source becomes a verifiable exact candidate with independent roles and no automatic landing.
deliverables: Protected check executor and complete source/diff manifest import.
Trusted-principal to Mote-actor bridge, current portable proposal/target-scope evidence and independent review workflow.
Inventory of applicable core implementation/review gates and exact selected baseline evidence.
acceptance: Worker test/policy edits, untracked files, deletion, rename, symlink and Git-hook tricks cannot evade protected acceptance.
Implementer cannot review or authorize itself; preserve current reviewer/authorizer separation.
A rewritten candidate cannot inherit review/authorization; unavailable or ambiguous checks never pass.
Use current candidate landability and target-scope checks; retain late-conflict incidents.
Reconcile the applicable open core gates against exact current source/binary rather than relying on stale issue status.
falsifiers: A hand-written candidate evidence op is automatically trusted as runner-verifier output.
The visible diff excludes files affecting the actual landing target.
release_blockers: Requalify applicable recovery/evidence identity/target-scope/provenance work before claiming release-grade acceptance.

tasks.title: Run the first sequential code pilot
tasks.outcome: A small representative set yields accepted candidates or useful explicit checkpoints after restart.
deliverables: Operator quickstart and installation/assurance requirements; human controls compose the same kernel.
Pilot receipt bundle covering ordinary repair, failed check, missing input, interruption, lost reply, permission revocation and exhausted budget.
Manual landing handoff and exact observation path for contracts requiring integration.
acceptance: Independent review accepts exact artifacts; request acceptance/process exit/task acceptance remain distinguishable.
Manual landing is stated as outstanding until observed; no managed completion is manufactured from an ordinary close.
Status, waiting and mechanical continuation make zero model calls.
Publish all pilot failures, checkpoints, usage uncertainty and human interventions; no economic victory claim yet.
falsifiers: The cold-start operator needs transcript archaeology.
The pilot silently drops tasks that exceeded budget.
release_blockers: Every enabled profile must have current conformance; retained unknown effects block replacements.

tasks.title: Add serialized exact-commit integration
tasks.outcome: An authorized candidate can fast-forward a controller-owned target with recoverable Git/Mote effects.
deliverables: Journaled integration intent, expected-old-OID Git operation and exact landing receipts.
Controller-owned target/workspace policy; remote push separately configured and authorized.
Incident and reconciliation flow for Git success followed by log failure or external target movement.
acceptance: Inject failure before/after ref mutation and before/after Mote publication; never duplicate effects or infer atomicity.
Refresh target scope and authorization; rewrite requires a successor candidate.
Refuse shared dirty/checked-out user target mutation and all force/reset rollback paths.
Out-of-band landing remains distinct from governed landing; late contradictions remain visible.
falsifiers: A successful Git operation closes the task without current landing evidence.
Target movement is repaired by silently rebasing an approved commit.
release_blockers: Applicable core candidate review/release gates must be independently discharged for the pinned baseline.

tasks.title: Add independent analysis-artifact acceptance
tasks.outcome: A scientific task can be accepted against exact inputs and outputs without a synthetic code commit.
deliverables: Typed estimand, unit, data manifest, preprocessing, split/exclusion/missingness, seed and tolerance contract.
Independent artifact receipts and protected evaluation fixture access.
Separate analysis pilot with no hidden dependence on code-candidate completion.
acceptance: Missing outputs and missing coverage fail; numerical tolerances and denominators stay frozen.
Independent reference calculations catch a plausible but wrong result.
Held-out answers never enter worker context or lessons; sanitation retains provenance.
Artifact, environment or input drift invalidates applicability without rewriting historical results.
falsifiers: A successful scheduler/process exit substitutes for validated output.
Repeated attempts use leaked evaluation answers.
release_blockers: If analysis becomes the first workload, complete this path and its pilot before claiming first usable release; MR-09 alone is insufficient.

tasks.title: Freeze and run the paired product evaluation
tasks.outcome: Evidence separates interface value from model substitution and counts the whole workflow.
deliverables: Preregistered matched same-profile flat-CLI versus situation-interface protocol.
Frozen acceptance criteria, severity-based defect rubric, quality noninferiority margin and minimum worthwhile economic change.
Paired task results, all failures, confidence/uncertainty, contamination controls and human-time accounting.
acceptance: Freeze thresholds before outcomes are viewed; do not choose them post hoc.
Include all assigned tasks and all construction, check, review, repair and maintenance costs.
Report acceptance fraction, escaped defects and resources per assigned task; report total resources divided by accepted outcomes with failed-task spending in the numerator.
Use paired/randomized order or fresh task variants; keep evaluator answers and future lessons separate.
A 30–50-task pilot reports limited precision and cannot certify rare-defect parity; inconclusive economics blocks benefit claims, not honest reliability reporting.
falsifiers: Only successful runs enter the cost denominator.
Changing models between conditions is called an interface improvement.
release_blockers: No empirical routing or promoted-lesson rollout justified solely by the aspirational 50% frontier reduction.

tasks.title: Qualify a second profile and deterministic routing
tasks.outcome: Provider choice has a measured, inspectable basis within unchanged authority and quality policy.
deliverables: Second profile conformance under the same job/assurance contract.
Task-class eligibility table and deterministic policy selection.
Cross-provider artifact/context handoff and drift invalidation.
acceptance: Privacy, capability, independence and assurance filter eligibility before cost selection.
Held-out stratified comparisons include review, repair, failures and human cost.
Fail provider/qualification and prove no silent forbidden fallback or parent-budget reset.
falsifiers: Raw acceptance totals across unequal workloads determine the preferred model.
Subscription headroom is treated as freely exchangeable API money.
release_blockers: One independently qualified route remains available; otherwise checkpoint.

tasks.title: Qualify selective lesson reuse
tasks.outcome: Only independently supported, applicable knowledge enters later context automatically.
deliverables: Proposed/promoted/retired lifecycle with separate applicability, provenance, sensitivity and invalidators.
Small lexical/path/tag retrieval and contradiction display.
Held-out ablation including promotion/maintenance costs and misleading retrieval.
acceptance: Retirement, counterexample and source drift prevent future automatic inclusion.
A lesson never changes policy, authority or the active contract.
No mandatory summarizer; failed lessons remain auditable and evaluation material stays protected.
Predefined benefit threshold and error limits must pass before default-on inclusion.
falsifiers: Several summaries of one source count as independent corroboration.
A retired instruction persists in cached context.
release_blockers: Unmeasured or harmful retrieval stays disabled.

tasks.title: Qualify two-worker execution
tasks.outcome: Two bounded workers share resources safely while integration remains serialized.
deliverables: Explicit worker slots, scoped ownership and parent/domain resource reservations.
Failure-injection tests with competing controllers, late Mote operations and overlapping tasks.
Sequential fallback and measured comparison with the same workload.
acceptance: No duplicate launch or oversubscribed managed budget during controller death/recovery races.
Observed conflicting reservation blocks acceptance and contains affected work.
One frontier execution at most under the initial policy; native children stay accounted.
Concurrency must improve the frozen metric without worsening the acceptance floor.
falsifiers: A lease expiring allows a replacement while the original worker continues.
Shared-account limits are claimed across unregistered controllers.
release_blockers: Do not enable concurrency to mask poor single-worker economics or unresolved recovery.

tasks.title: Optimize views and evidence reuse conservatively
tasks.outcome: Reduced context and redundant computation preserve exact provenance and dependency correctness.
deliverables: Exact-base deltas and explicit full-view recovery.
Complete check-input/environment closure and freshness rules where knowable.
Fresh candidate-bound receipts under an explicitly reviewed equivalence rule.
acceptance: Wrong/missing delta base forces a full view; revocations and contradictions survive compaction.
Unknown dependency closure forbids acceptance-grade reuse.
Mutate source, check, environment, seed, policy and external dependency independently; affected reuse rejects.
No review or authorization transfers to a rewritten candidate.
falsifiers: A matching file name or patch shape transfers an old pass.
The cached summary loses an uncertainty or required constraint.
release_blockers: Keep exact-attempt reuse only if complete closure cannot be established.
